review_redaction.purpose: Reviewer-facing derived copy (decision D-EXPORT-03), not the frozen file. Observed fields (outcomes of probes, smokes and pilots, token counts, real costs, real-run dates, corrections about earlier reports, paths under runs/) are removed; every settings field is unchanged.
review_redaction.removed: nothing: no observed field was found

scope: first-party smoke for Claude Sonnet 5 on item CB221, 16 calls. Pilot and full are not covered.

model.endpoint: Anthropic SDK default base URL (first-party API)
model.lifecycle_note: The Sonnet 5 overview page calls Claude Sonnet 5 a legacy model; Claude Sonnet 5.5 is the current Sonnet. Sonnet 5.5 rejects thinking {type: 'disabled'}, so the design's settings would not carry over to it. Availability of Sonnet 5 for the full collection is to be watched.

request_settings_on_the_wire.sdk_retries: max_retries=0 on the client; the runner makes one attempt per task

thinking_disabled.evidence: Sonnet 5 accepts thinking {type: 'disabled'}. Omitting the field defaults to adaptive thinking, so it is sent explicitly.
thinking_disabled.to_confirm_in_smoke: the request is accepted, no thinking or redacted_thinking block is returned, and the thinking count is zero if reported

sampling_parameters.evidence: Sonnet 5 rejects non-default temperature, top_p and top_k with HTTP 400, whether or not thinking is active. The Messages API reference documents a default temperature of 1.0.
sampling_parameters.handling: temperature, top_p and top_k are never sent (request setting sampling_parameters 'omit'). Each record keeps temperature_requested from the manifest, temperature_parameter_sent null and temperature_control 'unavailable'.

max_tokens.evidence: Generation stops at max_tokens with stop_reason 'max_tokens'; a normal finish is 'end_turn'. No minimum value was found in what was read.
max_tokens.to_confirm_in_smoke: a cap of 1 is accepted and can return a complete '0' or '1'; under a one-token cap a valid label may still arrive with stop_reason 'max_tokens', so the strict parser, not the stop reason, decides the label

fields.input_tokens: uncached input only, after the last cache breakpoint
fields.cache_creation_input_tokens: cache writes, with a cache_creation breakdown by TTL
fields.output_tokens: inclusive and authoritative for billing, thinking included
fields.output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens: thinking tokens, a read-only breakdown; recorded as null and 'not reported' when absent

thinking_blocks.handling: content blocks of type thinking and redacted_thinking are counted on every response; any such block stops the segment under the stop_if_positive guard

returned_model_string.evidence: Nothing read states whether the response reports 'claude-sonnet-5' or a dated snapshot name. The contract expects 'claude-sonnet-5' exactly; a different string stops the segment after the first call, which is recorded.

prompt_caching.evidence: Caching applies to blocks marked with cache_control; this route sends none. Minimum cacheable length for Sonnet 5 is 1,024 tokens.

design_deviation.carlson: The design asks for T=0. Sonnet 5 receives no temperature and decodes at its default. This deviates from the Carlson replication on this model and must be reported.
design_deviation.camuffo: The design asks for T=1, which is the documented default; the parameter is still not sent.
design_deviation.recorded_as: temperature_requested 0 or 1, temperature_parameter_sent null, temperature_control 'unavailable', sampling_parameters_policy 'omit'

tariff.caveat: One page lists a $0.10 cache-read rate, which belongs to Sonnet 5.5. Batch rates are not used. Confirm on the pricing page before authorising a paid run. A changed rate needs a new snapshot id and a new route version.
tariff.code: python/src/chapter3/first_party.py, TARIFFS[snapshot_id]; the test suite checks the two agree

cost_estimate.formula: input_tokens x input + cache_read_input_tokens x cache_read + cache writes by TTL (5m x cache_write_5m, 1h x cache_write_1h) + output_tokens x output
cost_estimate.no_double_count: thinking tokens are already inside output_tokens and are not added again
cost_estimate.missing_ttl_breakdown: every written token is priced at the dearer one-hour rate
cost_estimate.use: operational budget guard (--max-usd). Not the bill.
